scope: Same-job Roofline/GEMM structural model versus empirical estimator; warm prefill only, no scheduling change

method.hardware_probes: Q8_0 GEMM 1024x3072x512, F16 GEMM 128x4096x512, 64MiB copy; 2 warmup + 7 samples each; effective rates include graph synchronization
method.roofline_traffic: one KV read pass per decode chunk proxy, not measured DRAM traffic; norms/rope/activation omitted

limits: One machine/model/backend; primitive effective rates are proxies, not hardware peak values or pure GPU timestamps
No cold-start, queue, KV-file restore, agent ETA or arbitrary-program complexity estimate
fit_mae is a fitting residual, not a confidence interval; range-based extrapolation is only a warning
Online consumes past evaluation observations after prediction; frozen consumes calibration only
Prediction quality improvement is not measured model-inference speedup; estimator overhead reported separately

unit.scope: hand-derived FLOPs/bytes, valid/invalid GQA, per-chunk logits, unknown rates, invalid-input atomicity, profile isolation, synthetic unseen-shape fit; original cost regression

sanitizers.scope: C cost/roofline and independent unit tests; model library not instrumented
